about: Special campaign days of the special summary revisions with 1 January 2027 as the qualifying date, on which booth level officers sit at the polling stations to take claims and objections. The Commission's letter of 15 October 2026 left the days to each Chief Electoral Officer. Two readings, 13 November 2026. West Bengal's eight days, the Saturdays and Sundays from 28 November to 20 December set in press note No. 75/CEO/PN/2026 of 13 November 2026, were taken out on 21 November 2026, because press note No. 77/CEO/PN/2026 of 20 November postponed the revision there from 23 November onwards and gave no new dates. Press note No. 78/CEO/PN/2026 of 27 November 2026 gave the revision new dates and eight new days, the Saturdays and Sundays from 19 December 2026 to 10 January 2027, which were added on 27 November 2026.

days.source: CEO Andaman and Nicobar Islands, press release of 12.11.2026, printed in The Daily Telegrams, 13.11.2026
days.quote: During the claims and objections period, special camps will be conducted at all Polling Stations of Andaman & Nicobar Islands Parliamentary Constituency on 21st November, 2026 (Saturday) and 22nd November, 2026 (Sunday) from 9 AM to 5 PM. Booth Level Officers (BLOs) will be available at their respective polling stations on these days to assist electors.
Special campaign dates have been scheduled for November 21, November 22, December 5 and December 6, while the last date for disposal of claims and objections is December 28.

days.source: Live Hindustan (Hindustan bureau, Patna), 20.11.2026, reporting the Chief Electoral Officer's direction to all District Election Officers
days.quote: इसके तहत पहले अभियान दिवस का आयोजन 21 नवंबर (शनिवार) एवं 22 नवंबर (रविवार) को होगा। ... वहीं, इसके बाद पुन: 5 एवं 6 दिसंबर को विशेष अभियान दिवस का आयोजन किया जाएगा।

days.source: CEO Goa, press note No.4-1-2026/ELEC/2852 of 11.11.2026
days.quote: During the Specials Camps to be held on 28/11/2026 & 29/11/2026 (Saturday & Sunday) and 05/12/2026 & 06/12/2026 (Saturday & Sunday), the concerned BLO will be available on the polling booth for acceptance of the forms.

days.source: Mediasaheb, 12.11.2026, report of the Chief Electoral Officer's meeting with recognised parties
days.quote: इसके लिए 21 एवं 22 नवंबर तथा 5 एवं 6 दिसंबर को विशेष अभियान आयोजित किए जाएंगे।

days.source: The South First, 12.11.2026, reporting the District Election Officer of Puducherry
days.quote: Special camps will be conducted on 21, 22, 28 and 29 November to facilitate applications for inclusion, deletion and correction of voter details.

days.source: CEO Punjab, post of 21.11.2026 on x.com/TheCEOPunjab
days.quote: Special Camp at all polling booths across Punjab 22 November 2026 (Sunday) 10 AM to 4 PM

days.source: News On AIR, 12.11.2026, reporting what the Chief Electoral Officer said
days.quote: Special camps will be conducted on the 21st ,22nd and 29th of this month at the designated locations where electoral rolls will be available and electors can check their details and include their names in the required forms at the Centre itself.

days.source: CEO Uttar Pradesh, press note of 13.11.2026 on the review of preparations in Ghaziabad, posted on x.com/ceoup
days.quote: 21, 22 तथा 28, 29 नवम्बर को सभी मतदेय स्थलों पर विशेष अभियान दिवसों का किया जाएगा आयोजन

days.source: CEO Uttarakhand, minutes of the meeting with recognised parties of 22.10.2026, No.1899/XXV-31/2026 of 23.10.2026
days.quote: विशेष संक्षिप्त पुनरीक्षण के दौरान पात्र नागरिकों के पंजीकरण को बढ़ावा देने हेतु दिनांक 21 नवम्बर एवं 28 नवम्बर, 2026 को विशेष अभियान दिवस निर्धारित किए गए हैं।

days.source: CEO West Bengal, press note No. 78/CEO/PN/2026 of 27.11.2026, posted on x.com/CEOWestBengal
days.quote: Special Campaign Days will be organized on 19th, 20th, 26th, 27th December, 2nd , 3rd , 9th, 10th January 2027 (Saturday and Sunday) across all designated polling stations of the district. During these special campaign days, Booth Level Officers (BLOs) will remain present at their respective polling stations to assist eligible citizens with enrolment, submission of claims and objections, and other electoral roll-related services.
